scope: Persistent aidream deploy-cadence watch reliability repair; no manual release, build, deployment, workflow dispatch, native run, or product health claim
observed_problem: At 09:50 UTC the last observed successful deploy.yml start remained 08:37:30 UTC, while the most recent scheduled cadence-watch run was 07:17:56 UTC. GitHub documents that scheduled workflow events can be delayed or dropped at high load; this does not prove why this particular event was absent.

change.behavior: Main runtime-bearing pushes now wake the existing cadence watch in addition to its unchanged 10-minute schedule. Documentation, workflow, research, and test-only pushes are excluded from push wakeups and from the last-runtime-commit classifier. Watch runs serialize without cancelling an active run. The existing >45-minute threshold, newer-runtime-commit requirement, no-active-deploy guard, dry-run behavior, and immutable release_ref dispatch remain intact.
change.self_trigger: The repair unit changes only .github/workflows, tests, scripts/FEATURE.md, and this .research JSON, all excluded by push paths-ignore. Its own push is not intended to wake the watch or start a deploy.
change.limit: A runtime push after an already eligible breach may cause the existing watch to dispatch automatically. This is the authorized standing recovery behavior, not a manual dispatch or a new periodic schedule. The schedule remains necessary when there is no subsequent runtime push.

verification.format_lint: .venv/bin/ruff format and .venv/bin/ruff check passed for the focused test file
verification.red_green: The two new tests fail against the pre-change workflow: absent runtime-push trigger and test-only commit incorrectly selected as latest runtime candidate; both pass against the changed workflow. The classifier test executes the workflow's actual shell pathspec in a temporary Git repository across docs/workflow/research/test-only and runtime commits.
verification.docs_checks: python3 scripts/check_doc_links.py and scripts/check_docs_guards.py remain red on unrelated pre-existing pointers and one unrelated skill-title claim; this unit changes none of those locations.
verification.live_limit: No GitHub workflow run or production deployment was initiated or verified by this unit. Independent source review and subsequent automation observation are required before promotion.
